summary: Save web pages, selections, files and the text in screenshots to Imprint, the local memory your AI assistants search. Everything goes to Imprint on your own computer.

screenshots.caption: Save what you read in one click: pages, highlights, files and screenshots go straight to Imprint on your computer.
See exactly what gets saved. Edit it, pick a workspace and project, then save.
Keep just the part that matters: highlight a passage and save only that, with the page it came from.
Read any page with local OCR: capture the visible area or the whole page, and Imprint reads the text on your computer.
Find it again, or let your AI assistant find it: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients search the same memory.
